BiblicalUsage: Yâshâr is the straight and upright one, the person and the way that do not bend. The psalmist says righteous art Thou, O LORD, and upright are Thy judgments, and Moses sang that His work is perfect and just and right is He. Proverbs says the integrity of the upright shall guide them, and the word of the LORD is right and all His works are done in truth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe uprightness is not a posture but a Person, and God's straightness is the measure of my own. My position is that the upright are guided by their integrity, and the crooked fall by their own perverseness. And I hold that the God who is just and right will make all things right in the end.
